# Muhammad Hamza — Software Engineer & AI Developer

> Canonical Identity: Muhammad Hamza (Peshawar, Pakistan) — Software Engineer, AI Developer, and Creator of Quizior.

Muhammad Hamza is a Software Engineer and AI Developer based in Peshawar, Pakistan. He developed a QAC-based college ranking system for the Higher Education Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, is the Main Developer of Quizior, and is Co-Founder of Solvia Codes.

- [HED College Ranking System](https://ranking.qac.hed.gkp.pk): QAC-based ranking platform for public-sector colleges in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
- [AiVerse](https://aiverse.ehubinstitute.com): AI-assisted web platform created for an IELTS academy
